# GLFW 3.4

Official precompiled Windows binaries from https://www.glfw.org/download
https://github.com/glfw/glfw/releases/tag/3.4

Headers and static-UCRT DLL/import-library pairs are included for x64 and Win32.
This keeps builds independent of user-specific paths and avoids requiring a
separate Visual C++ runtime installation for the release package.
See LICENSE.md for the GLFW license. Keep the DLL and license with distributions.
